annotations.title: Get typical home job costs from public records

description: Median and middle half (25th to 75th percentile) of what common home jobs cost, from two kinds of public record. (1) Rebate, loan and incentive program records in Oregon, New York, Massachusetts, Connecticut and Delaware: installed cost of heat pumps, solar, battery storage and weatherization, statewide and by county or city. (2) City permit files in 23 US cities and counties (San Francisco, Los Angeles, Seattle, Portland, Austin, Miami-Dade and others): the job value declared on the permit for water heaters (tank, tankless, heat pump), heat pumps, mini splits, furnaces, air conditioners, sewer lines, re-pipes, roof replacements, electrical panels, solar, EV chargers and kitchen and bath remodels, kept to single-job permits at one home. Each permit series gives value_listed_share, the share of the job's permits that list a value at all; where low_value_coverage is true (under a quarter), the median is not the typical job, so do not quote it as one. A declared permit valuation is the applicant's estimate, not a paid price, and often runs low; say so when you quote one. Job words such as "hot water heater", "sewer line" or "AC" and city or county names ("Portland" also finds Multnomah County) are understood. Use it to tell a user whether a quote is in the usual range, and cite the source.

area.description: City or county, e.g. "Seattle", "Oakland" or "Multnomah". Default: statewide program series and every city's permit series.

job.description: The job, e.g. "water heater", "sewer line", "AC", "heat pump", "roof", "solar", "weatherization".

name: get_prices

job_read_as.description: The job type the job words were read as, e.g. "water_heater" for "hot water heater".

kind.description: "declared_permit_valuation" for values declared on city permits (the applicant's estimate, not a paid price); absent for rebate and program costs.

low_value_coverage.description: Permit series only: true when under a quarter of the job's permits list a value, so the median describes a minority filed another way, not the typical job. Do not quote it as a typical price.

value_listed_share.description: Permit series only: share of that place's home permits for the job that list a declared value at all, 0 to 1.

total.description: Series that matched; at most 25 are returned.
